name: avg_fb_velo
rationale: Current FF/SI/FC mean velocity; primary pitch speed signal.

name: fb_velo_change_vs_prev_3
rationale: Short-term speed deviation from strictly prior outings.

name: velo_drop_game
rationale: Late minus early fastball speed in disjoint 20-pitch segments; requires 40 fastballs.

name: velo_z
rationale: Speed deviation scaled to pitcher-specific prior variability.

name: fb_velo_slope_prev_5
rationale: Speed trend over prior five appearances.

name: release_x_z
rationale: Lateral release deviation relative to personal baseline.

name: release_z_z
rationale: Release height deviation relative to personal baseline.

name: extension_z
rationale: Extension deviation relative to personal baseline.

name: arm_angle_avg
rationale: Observed arm angle; use only in empirically supported modern seasons.

name: spin_avg
rationale: Mean observed spin; pitch mix must be considered.

name: vertical_movement_avg
rationale: Observed vertical movement in feet; not substituted for native IVB.

name: sl_usage_pct
rationale: Slider share, including true zeros when unused.

name: zone_pct
rationale: Fraction of measured zones inside 1 through 9.

name: zone_pct_change_vs_prev_5
rationale: Zone rate deviation from prior outings.

name: walk_rate
rationale: Official current walks per batter faced.

name: total_pitches
rationale: Current physical pitch workload, available after the appearance.

name: innings_pitched
rationale: Current official outs divided by three.

name: rest_days
rationale: Days without pitching since prior MLB outing.

name: pitches_prev_7d
rationale: Prior seven-day physical workload from official pitch counts.

name: season_pitch_count
rationale: Year-to-date pitch total through prediction appearance.

name: previous_season_innings
rationale: Completed preceding-year innings, never future current-season total.

name: workload_acceleration_7d_vs_21d
rationale: Recent daily pitch load minus previous three-week daily load.

name: acute_chronic_pitch_ratio
rationale: Seven-day relative to 28-day pitch rate; descriptive exposure, not a causal threshold.

name: starter_share_prev_5
rationale: Recent role context distinguishes opener/rotation transitions.

name: throws_left
rationale: Observed hand from this appearance, NULL if inconsistent or unavailable.

name: documented_prior_ucl
rationale: Documented procedure before this date; absence means no record, not confirmed no history.

name: observed_prior_mlb_starts
rationale: Prior observed MLB starts; left-truncated at study start, not full career.

name: days_since_mlb_debut
rationale: Elapsed days since recorded debut, not future career length.

name: release_x_sd_z
rationale: Existing pitcher-relative release variability for descriptive trajectories; outside the fixed v1 predictor set.

name: release_z_sd_z
rationale: Existing pitcher-relative release variability for descriptive trajectories; outside the fixed v1 predictor set.

name: is_starter
rationale: Official role in the completed prediction outing.

name: prior_reported_il_count
rationale: Count of prior placements reported strictly before this date; not career injuries.

name: calendar_month
rationale: Calendar context available on the prediction date.
